headline: Methods separate cell abundance from state and infer regulatory trajectories
label: Spatial Deconvolution And Mechanistic Trajectories
summary: Single-cell and spatial methods now couple regulatory inference, trajectory dynamics and spatial deconvolution within testable computational frameworks.
synthesis: The dominant thread is decomposing single-cell and spatial measurements into distinct sources of variation. ARCADE separates cell-type abundance from continuous intratype state, SWIMR integrates multiple scRNA-seq references with spatial correlations for deconvolution, and Tracel reassigns transcripts or bin counts to cells via two-stage optimal transport. FICTURE2 infers transcriptional programs for individual RNA molecules from gene identity and spatial context. A second thread makes trajectories mechanistic: bowside jointly infers trajectories and gene regulatory networks, ManifoldVelo couples pseudotime with RNA velocity, and LOTUS adds lineage barcodes to unbalanced optimal transport. Several items couple these layers rather than estimating them separately, while BioTrajX provides metrics for assessing the biological plausibility of inferred trajectories.
